name: drawingset-mep-provenance
description: MEP layer G1 PR5 — the drawing set's electrical sheet prefers a persisted `electricalPoints` array (authored via the floor-plan MEP tool) over the furniture-derived heuristic: asserts the 'Points as designed' provenance note + an '@1200' mount-height suffix appear in the captured HTML once a point is added. openDrawingSet() opens a new window and calls document.write; window.open is intercepted (stub capturing the written HTML) so the real popup never spawns.

steps.name: patch-window-open
steps.eval: window.__capturedHtml = null; window.__origWindowOpen = window.open; window.open = function () { return { document: { write: function (html) { window.__capturedHtml = html }, close: function () {} }, close: function () {}, focus: function () {}, print: function () {} }; };

steps.name: click-drawing-set
steps.eval: (function(){ const btn = [...document.querySelectorAll('.pop-panel button')].find(b => b.textContent.includes('Drawing set')); if (!btn) throw new Error('Drawing set button not found'); btn.click(); })()

steps.name: wait-html-captured
steps.failMessage: openDrawingSet() never wrote HTML via the intercepted window.open

steps.name: assert-as-designed-provenance
steps.eval: (function(){ if (!window.__capturedHtml.includes('Points as designed')) throw new Error('Drawing set HTML missing the "Points as designed" provenance note for a persisted electrical point'); if (!window.__capturedHtml.includes('@1200')) throw new Error('Drawing set HTML missing the @1200 mount-height suffix'); window.open = window.__origWindowOpen; })()
